description: This file contains shell script functions for managing device upgrades on Linux-based systems, specifically for handling disk partition checks, upgrades, and copying configuration during upgrades.

methods.name: mbl_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks if the partition layout on the device has changed before upgrading.

methods.name: mbl_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process by writing images to device partitions, handling layout changes, and copying partition UUIDs.

methods.name: mbl_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to a specific partition during upgrade.
